model: Asia Cold Flow Chemistry System (Advanced, with Asia Cryo Controller)
description: Pre-configured continuous-flow system for cryogenic (e.g. organometallic) chemistry; the Advanced system uses the electrically cooled Asia Cryo Controller (microreactors to -100 °C, tube reactors to -70 °C) without dry ice or liquid nitrogen; 1 uL/min-10 mL/min, 0-20 bar, 4 pump channels, system temperature -100 °C to +250 °C.

configurations.configuration_basis: Advanced configuration of the Asia Cold Flow Chemistry System (4 pump channels, chip/tube/column reactors, automation) with the Asia Cryo Controller fitted with the microreactor adaptor (2200722) and the 250 uL low-temp microreactor chip (2200726); manufacturer specifications.

unknowns.why: The spec table shows Advanced 'System temperature -100 °C to +250 °C', but the +250 °C comes from the system's heating modules. This configuration is the Cryo Controller with a low-temperature microreactor chip (FFKM seals), which is a cooling module, and nothing documents +250 °C for it. The range is not shown to apply to this exact configuration.
The absence rests only on the silence of a short marketing spec table on the product page. There is no complete specification and no explicit statement.
The cited quote mentions a nitrogen purge and clear insulation and says nothing about vacuum. 'No evacuated sample space' is inferred, not stated.
This absence rests on inference from a 0-20 bar flow spec. No explicit statement or complete specification.
